description.value: A large-format Walmart Supercentre on the Island Highway North corridor in Nanaimo, offering full grocery and general merchandise departments. As one of the largest retail stores in the area, it is a significant resupply point for touring cyclists navigating Vancouver Island. The store serves a broad range of needs beyond groceries, including clothing, electronics, and baby supplies.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record clearly identifies this as a Walmart Supercentre (shop=supermarket) at 6801 Island Highway North, Nanaimo. The website's front-page fragment loaded and confirms grocery services ('grocery, Electronics, Toys, Clothing, Furniture, Baby | Store 3059'), corroborating the OSM category. Most subpages were blocked by Walmart's anti-bot CAPTCHA, so no detailed amenity information (bike parking, washrooms, etc.) could be extracted from the website.
concerns: Most website subpages were blocked by Walmart's anti-bot CAPTCHA verification, preventing confirmation of amenity details such as bike parking, washrooms, and hot food.
No phone number is present in the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A Walmart Supercentre is a major, reliable grocery resupply point for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island; basic groceries are confirmed and the store is clearly open.
